title: Preparation of mouse pancreatic tumor for single-cell RNA sequencing
author: Surumbayeva, Kotliar, et al.

steps.title: Reconstitute Tumor Dissociation Enzymes
steps.instruction: Reconstitute lyophilized Enzyme D, Enzyme R and Enzyme A from the Mouse Tumor Dissociation Kit using the volumes in Table 1, aliquot and store.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 mL DRP (DMEM or RPMI‑1640) to the lyophilized Enzyme D and mix gently (do not vortex).
Add 2.7 mL RRP (DMEM or RPMI‑1640) to the lyophilized Enzyme R and mix gently.
Add 1 mL Buffer A to the lyophilized Enzyme A; do not vortex.
Aliquot 100 µL Enzyme D, 50 µL Enzyme R and 12.5 µL Enzyme A per sample.
Store aliquots at –20 °C; solutions remain stable for 6 months.

steps.title: Prepare Cold PBS
steps.instruction: Prepare sterile 1× PBS (Ca²⁺‑ and Mg²⁺‑free) and pre‑cool it at +4 °C.

steps.title: Pre‑cool Centrifuge
steps.instruction: Set the centrifuge temperature to +4 °C before any spin.

steps.title: Prepare Binding Buffer
steps.instruction: Dilute the 20× Binding Buffer Stock (Dead Cell Removal Kit) in sterile double‑distilled water to 1×; do not use deionized water and ensure Ca²⁺ is present (no EDTA).

steps.title: Observe Animal Welfare
steps.instruction: Monitor tumor‑bearing mice twice weekly; euthanize when sickness, distress, or >10 % body‑weight loss occurs, following IACUC guidelines, and perform all manipulations under BSL‑2 conditions.

steps.title: Optional Red Blood Cell Lysis
steps.instruction: If the cell pellet is intensely red, perform RBC lysis (≈15 min total).

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 10 × pellet volume of 1× Red Blood Cell Lysis Solution.
Vortex 5 s, then incubate 2 min at 18–25 °C.
Discard supernatant and proceed to the next step.

steps.title: Resuspend and Filter Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 0.5 mL DMEM + 1 % FBS and filter through a 70 µm Flowmi™ Tip Strainer.

steps.title: Count Viable Cells
steps.instruction: Determine cell concentration and viability using Trypan Blue and a hemocytometer; repeat with two separate aliquots.

substeps.instruction: Mix an aliquot with Trypan Blue and count live cells.
Repeat the count with a second aliquot.
Confirm single, well‑separated cells and ≥90 % viability; if not, repeat dead‑cell removal and filtering.

steps.title: Adjust Cell Concentration
steps.instruction: Dilute or concentrate the suspension in DMEM + 1 % FBS to reach 700–1200 cells µL⁻¹, with a total of at least 7 000–12 000 cells (≈1:1 cell‑to‑bead ratio for the 10× Chromium kit).

steps.title: Create SciDAP Project
steps.instruction: Log in or register at https://scidap.com, click “New Project”, enter a title and subtitle (optional abstract), and save.

steps.title: Attach Required Workflows
steps.instruction: In the project, attach the following workflows: Cell Ranger Build Reference Indices, Cell Ranger Count Gene Expression, Cell Ranger Aggregate, and Seurat Cluster.

steps.title: Build Mouse Reference Indices
steps.instruction: Add a new experiment, select “Cell Ranger Build Reference Indices”, give an experiment short name, choose “Mus musculus (mm10)”, keep default settings, save and wait for successful completion.

steps.title: Quantify Gene Expression
steps.instruction: For each sequencing dataset, add a new experiment, select “Cell Ranger Count Gene Expression”, assign a short name, choose the reference indices, attach FASTQ files via SRR accession numbers, and run.

substeps.instruction: Provide the SRR accession (e.g., geo://SRR12450154) for FASTQ R1 and R2 using the “Attach from URL” or “File Manager” tabs.
Repeat the above for all five datasets.
Ensure each run finishes without error before proceeding.

steps.title: Aggregate Datasets Without Normalization
steps.instruction: Add a new analysis, select “Cell Ranger Aggregate”, give a short name, select all five Cell Ranger Count experiments, set Library depth normalization mode to “None”, save and wait for completion.

steps.title: Prepare Condition File

steps.title: Run Seurat Clustering
steps.instruction: Add a new analysis, select “Seurat Cluster”, give a short name, choose the Cell Ranger Aggregate experiment, upload condition.csv, and set advanced parameters as listed (Adjusted values).

substeps.instruction: - Include cells with ≥300 genes detected (adjusted from 250).
- Genes of interest = Clec3b, Il6, Lgals7, Pdgfra, Vim, Tgfb1, Ptprc, Epcam, Cldn4, Krt7, Sox9, Cdh1, Upk3b, Mki67.

steps.title: Explore QC and Clustering Results (Optional)
steps.instruction: Use the QC (filtered), Dimensionality, Clustering, Gene expression, and Putative gene markers tabs in SciDAP to view cell‑count bar plots, violin plots, elbow plot, UMAP, dot/feature/violin plots, and to download the seurat_clst_data.rds file; optionally export barcodes via the UCSC Cell Browser.

description:
1.Prepare reagents Enzyme D, Enzyme R, Enzyme A by reconstitution of the lyophilized powders from the Tumor Dissociation Kit(mouse) according to Table 1. Make aliquots (100 μL of Enzyme D, 50 μL of Enzyme R, and 12.5 μL of Enzyme A per sample) and store them at −20°C, to avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles. These solutions are stable for 6 months after reconstitution.Table 1Media and reagentsEnzymeReconstitution solutionVolumeNotesDRPMI 1640 or DMEM3 mLfilter (0.22 μm) prior to aliquotingRRPMI 1640 or DMEM2.7 mLABuffer A1 mLdo not vortex2.Prepare sterile 1× PBS (Ca2+ and Mg2+ free). Pre-cool PBS at +4°C.3.Prepare sterile, double-distilled water.4.Pre-cool the centrifuge to +4°C.5.Prepare the necessary stock solutions and sterile tools according to the materials and equipment section.6.Prepare 1× Binding Buffer from 20× Binding Buffer Stock Solution supplied with the Dead Cell Removal Kit by diluting in double-distilled water.
CRITICAL: Do not use deionized water for dilution.
CRITICAL: Binding of Dead Cell Removal MicroBeads requires Ca2+. The presence of the ion chelator EDTA will abolish binding. 1× Binding Buffer is optimized for best Dead Cell Removal MicroBeads binding. The use of a different buffer may lead to poor dead cell removal efficiency.
CRITICAL: Mouse primary tumor cells carry potentially hazardous pathogens. Procedures should be performed under BSL-2 conditions. Tumor-bearing mice were observed twice weekly until signs of sickness appeared or animals showed distress or weight loss of more than 10%, per the local Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC) guidelines.
